graduation.notes: Per-proposal accept: sandbox success AND no rollback threshold breach AND utility U strictly greater than baseline U. Review-frequency: separate clean-streak of 20 consecutive clean proposals (graduation-tracker.sh); any failure resets to 0.

autonomy.note: M7 steward-only contract: auto_mode is granted only when, over the rolling window, graduation streak is at/above target (require_graduated), zero unhealthy jobs, and auto-rollbacks stay under the cap. Otherwise steward_mode (human consulted for direction, exemptions, incidents).
